Disqualified from driving for three years and sentenced to eight weeks imprisonment suspended for 18 months. Charlie Daggers, 22, of Durham Way, Wyton, Huntingdon. Harry Edwards, 26, of no fixed abode. Between March and September 2026, committed multiple shop thefts. Sentenced to six weeks imprisonment suspended for 12 months and ordered to pay compensation. Curtis Challen, 35, of no fixed abode, Cambridge. On July 31 and August 1, 2026, committed assault by beating. Sentenced to 14 weeks imprisonment and ordered to pay £200 compensation. rawItems.title: Man accused of sexually assaulting woman near primary school named
rawItems.content:
A man accused of sexually assaulting a woman near a Huntingdonshire primary school has been named by police. Officers were called at around 7.25am on May 26 with reports of a sexual assault on a woman in her 50s in Ramsey Road, St Ives. According to Cambridgeshire Constabulary, the incident is alleged to have occurred near Westfield Junior School. Read more Boy arrested after money stolen during break-in at primary school

    Teens who left man with fractured skull in unprovoked attack avoid jail
    More than 60 babies remembered in St Ives memorial ribbon display
    Mayor warns devolved power over water services ‘a bit bonkers’ A 26-year-old man from St Ives was arrested on May 28 on suspicion of sexual assault and a public order offence. Sachin Sachin, of Carlisle Terrace, has since been charged with sexual assault on a female. He also faces two counts of using threatening/abusive words/behaviour likely to cause harassment, alarm or distress. He is due to appear at Cambridge Magistrates’ Court on November 5.
